body:
Hi Alberto,

I was trying to study this more with the latest release 1.26.1, and I think I understand why I "sometimes observed the behavior and sometimes did not". It appears to be related to the filetype. For CR3 files straight out of a Canon camera, if in ART I explicitly click on one to open it in the main editing window, then renaming the file in ART or even moving it outside ART is not possible until I close ART.

Interestingly, for DNG files that I have created with DxO from the original CR3 files, I do not experience this behavior. Regardless of whether I have opened a DNG file in the main editor, I can rename within ART on-demand, and I can move the file.

Based on the dialog box that pops up in ART when I try to rename a CR3 and fails, it is occurring [here](https://github.com/artraweditor/ART/blob/master/rtgui/filecatalog_rename.cc#L1100-L1113), where something in the if-condition is failing I guess. I am curious about the `doit` method, but I was not able to track that down.

In any case, some more information about this strange behavior.
